title: Linux Kernel variables
description: Configuration variables for the Linux Kernel multi-toolchain Kbuild engine

LINUX_VERSION.description: Specific version of the Linux kernel to install or compile (e.g., '6.6.52' or 'latest').

LINUX_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to provision the Linux kernel ('from-source' compiles via Kbuild, 'system' installs via OS package manager, 'libscript_native' stages prebuilt artifacts).

LINUX_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Toolchain used to compile the Linux kernel ('default', 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', 'custom-cc', or compiler binary path).

LINUX_COMPILER.description: Alias for LINUX_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN specifying the C compiler for Kbuild.

LINUX_HOSTCC.description: Host C compiler used for Kbuild host utilities (scripts/basic/fixdep, scripts/kconfig/conf).

LINUX_KCFLAGS.description: Extra KCFLAGS passed to the Linux kernel Kbuild invocation.

LINUX_SOURCE_URL.description: Optional explicit download URL for the Linux kernel source tarball.

LINUX_SHA256.description: Optional SHA-256 checksum for verifying the downloaded Linux kernel source archive.

LINUX_SYNTHETIC_FALLBACK.description: Whether to compile a freestanding multi-TU kernel ELF harness with the target compiler when full Linux kernel source is not cached locally.

LINUX_SOURCE_DIR.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for linux (LINUX_SOURCE_DIR).
